title: Demo application greeting and health checks

requirements.description: A visitor can submit a name and receive a personalized greeting.
The greeting form prevents submission when the required name is empty.
The health endpoint returns a successful JSON status.
The home page provides accessible controls and has no automated WCAG 2.2 AA violations.

scenarios.description: A visitor receives a personalized greeting after submitting a name.
preconditions: The demo application is available at the configured base URL.
steps: Enter Ada in the Your name field.
expectedResults: The status message reads Hello, Ada!.

scenarios.description: The required name field blocks submitting an empty greeting form.
preconditions: The demo application is available at the configured base URL.
steps: Submit the form without entering a name.
expectedResults: The name field is required and remains invalid when empty.

scenarios.description: The health endpoint returns HTTP 200 and a healthy JSON response.
preconditions: The demo application is available at the configured base URL.

scenarios.description: The home page exposes accessible controls and has no automated WCAG 2.2 AA violations.
preconditions: The demo application is available at the configured base URL.
steps: Scan the rendered page using axe WCAG 2.2 AA tags.
expectedResults: The automated axe scan reports no violations.
